device_entry.name: 串行控制组件
tags: 移动机器人与自动驾驶实验
device_entry.description: 这是一个非物理的软件控制组件，用于在 Donkeycar 风格的流程中通过串行通信链路更新并提供控制信号。根据现有证据，它主要围绕转向角和油门等信号进行运行、轮询或线程化读取，适合用于实验小车控制流程中的信号传递与集成。
device_entry.description_en: This is a non-physical software control component used in a Donkeycar-style workflow to update and provide control signals over a serial communication link. Based on the available evidence, it mainly handles run-loop, polling, or threaded access to signals such as steering angle and throttle, for integration within an experimental vehicle control pipeline.

schema.description: 运行一次串行控制处理并输出当前控制信号。
schema.description_en: Run one serial control cycle and output the current control signals.

schema.description: 在线程模式下运行串行控制并获取当前控制信号。
schema.description_en: Run the serial control component in threaded mode and obtain the current control signals.
